attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, Push the defender Away from this character |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Kinetic Burst
steps: When making this attack, during the pay |!power| cost step of the attack, this character may spend up to 3 additional |!power|. Add one die to this attack for each |!power| spent in this way.

|!wild| |*Explosive Force|: After this attack is resolved, other characters within |!range| 2 of this character are Pushed away from this character |!range_small|. Pushed characters suffer 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: King of Wakanda (Affiliation: Wakanda)
superPowers.body: While an allied character is attacking, defending, or dodging, during the Modify Dice step, it may spend 1 |!power|. If it does, it may reroll one of its dice.

superPowers.name: Mantle of the Black Panther
superPowers.body: When making attacks this turn this character may reroll any number of its attack dice.

superPowers.name: Pounce
superPowers.body: This character is thrown |!range_small|. It does not suffer |!damage| if it collides with another character or terrain feature. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Vibranium Armor
superPowers.body: When defending against |!physical| or |!energy| attacks, this character adds blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.

Strike's push is now limited to Size 3 or less instead of unlimited.
"During the Modify Dice step" timing indication added to King of Wakanda.
